turns.en: If it gets worse, or if you start to feel breathless or feverish, I want you to come straight back or ring 111. Don't wait for your appointment.
turns.cy: Os eith o'n waeth, neu os dach chi'n dechra teimlo'n fyr eich gwynt neu'n dwymynog, dw i isio i chi ddod yn ôl yn syth neu ffonio 111. Peidiwch ag aros am eich apwyntiad.
chunks: the short future in the if-clause
or if you start to feel breathless or feverish
neu os dach chi'n dechra teimlo'n fyr eich gwynt neu'n dwymynog
Welsh has no adjective for breathless — byr eich gwynt, 'short your breath', with the possessive agreeing with the subject
I want you to come straight back or ring 111
dw i isio i chi ddod yn ôl yn syth neu ffonio 111
English's ECM relocates to isio i + subject + verbal noun
Peidiwch ag aros am eich apwyntiad

turns.en: Right, I will do. Thank you, doctor.
turns.cy: Iawn, mi wna i. Diolch, doctor.
chunks: English's pro-verb 'do' erases — gwneud is already the verb

turns.en: Good. And I mean it about the breathlessness - that one's a same-day call, never a wait-and-see.
turns.cy: Da iawn. A dw i o ddifri am y diffyg gwynt — galwad yr un diwrnod ydy honno, byth aros i weld.
chunks: And I mean it about the breathlessness
A dw i o ddifri am y diffyg gwynt
English's 'mean it' relocates to o ddifri, 'in earnest' — the verb has no Welsh reflex here
that one's a same-day call, never a wait-and-see
galwad yr un diwrnod ydy honno, byth aros i weld
identificatory fronting; English's hyphenated noun becomes a Welsh verbal phrase

turns.cy: Diffyg gwynt, yr un diwrnod. Dallt.

turns.en: That's everything from me. Any last questions before you go?
turns.cy: Dyna bob dim gen i. Unrhyw gwestiynau ola cyn i chi fynd?
chunks: English's 'from me' relocates to the conjugated gen i
Any last questions before you go?
Unrhyw gwestiynau ola cyn i chi fynd?

turns.en: None, doctor. You've been very thorough. Thank you.
turns.cy: Dim un, doctor. Dach chi wedi bod yn drylwyr iawn. Diolch.
chunks: Dach chi wedi bod yn drylwyr iawn

turns.en: If it gets worse, or you feel breathless or feverish, come straight back or ring 111.
turns.cy: Os eith o'n waeth, neu os dach chi'n teimlo'n fyr eich gwynt neu'n dwymynog, dewch yn ôl yn syth neu ffoniwch 111.
chunks: or you feel breathless or feverish
neu os dach chi'n teimlo'n fyr eich gwynt neu'n dwymynog
⚠ line — the os must be restated, which English can omit
dewch yn ôl yn syth neu ffoniwch 111
⚠ line — imperatives, distinct from the ECM version at F01-S01

turns.en: What should I be looking out for, exactly? How bad is bad?
turns.cy: Am be'n union ddylwn i fod yn cadw golwg? Pa mor ddrwg ydy drwg?
chunks: What should I be looking out for, exactly?
Am be'n union ddylwn i fod yn cadw golwg?
⚠ line — Welsh fronts the preposition with the interrogative; 'look out for' becomes cadw golwg
⚠ line — pa mor is obligatory before the adjective

turns.en: Three things. Breathless just sitting still. Coughing up blood. Or a fever that won't come down with paracetamol. Any of those - same day, no waiting.
turns.cy: Tri pheth. Yn fyr eich gwynt yn ista'n llonydd. Pesychu gwaed. Neu dwymyn na ddaw i lawr efo paracetamol. Unrhyw un o'r rheiny — yr un diwrnod, dim aros.
chunks: ⚠ line — the aspirate mutation after tri, absorbed inside the chunk
Yn fyr eich gwynt yn ista'n llonydd
⚠ line — 'just' erases; the possessive in byr eich gwynt has to agree with the addressee
⚠ line — English's particle 'up' erases into pesychu
Or a fever that won't come down with paracetamol
Neu dwymyn na ddaw i lawr efo paracetamol
Any of those - same day, no waiting
Unrhyw un o'r rheiny — yr un diwrnod, dim aros

turns.en: Breathless sitting still, blood, fever that won't shift. I've got it.
turns.cy: Yn fyr eich gwynt yn ista'n llonydd, gwaed, twymyn na eith i ffwrdd. Mae o gen i.
chunks: Breathless sitting still, blood, fever that won't shift
Yn fyr eich gwynt yn ista'n llonydd, gwaed, twymyn na eith i ffwrdd
⚠ line — 'shift' for a symptom converges with 'go' → mynd, as at the cough
the gen i possessive, one form for the remembering-it intention
south: mae e gyda fi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Yn fyr eich gwynt yn ishte'n llonydd, gwaed, twymyn na aiff i ffwrdd. Mae e gyda fi.

turns.en: Good. Now say the three things back to me once more - I know it sounds daft, but it sticks better.
turns.cy: Da iawn. Rŵan deudwch y tri pheth yn ôl wrtha i unwaith eto — dw i'n gwybod ei fod o'n swnio'n wirion, ond mae o'n glynu'n well.
chunks: Now say the three things back to me once more
Rŵan deudwch y tri pheth yn ôl wrtha i unwaith eto
⚠ line — the teach-back, the single most load-bearing instruction in this scene
dw i'n gwybod ei fod o'n swnio'n wirion
gwybod for factual knowing (S5); the bod that-clause

turns.en: Breathless, blood, fever. There - word perfect.
turns.cy: Yn fyr fy ngwynt, gwaed, twymyn. Dyna ni — air am air.
chunks: Yn fyr fy ngwynt, gwaed, twymyn
⚠ line — the possessive inside byr … gwynt must switch to FIRST person when the patient says it back; English's 'breathless' does not move
English's 'word perfect' relocates to air am air, 'word for word'

turns.en: If it gets worse or you feel breathless, ring 111 or come straight back. Don't wait.
turns.cy: Os eith o'n waeth neu os dach chi'n teimlo'n fyr eich gwynt, ffoniwch 111 neu dewch yn ôl yn syth. Peidiwch ag aros.
chunks: If it gets worse or you feel breathless
Os eith o'n waeth neu os dach chi'n teimlo'n fyr eich gwynt
ffoniwch 111 neu dewch yn ôl yn syth
distinct from 'don't wait FOR your appointment'

turns.en: I don't like to make a fuss, that's my trouble. I'll leave it and leave it.
turns.cy: Dw i ddim isio gneud ffys — dyna fy nhraffarth i. Mi adawa i o ac adael iddo fo.
chunks: I don't like to make a fuss
Dw i ddim isio gneud ffys
English's reticence idiom relocates to a plain want-negative, as at SC05-F03-S04
I'll leave it and leave it
Mi adawa i o ac adael iddo fo
English repeats the same verb for delay; Welsh cannot, so the second limb takes the iddo fo dative of neglect

turns.en: Listen - the people who worry about making a fuss are exactly the ones who should ring. Promise me you will.
turns.cy: Gwrandwch — y bobl sy'n poeni am neud ffys ydy'n union y rhai ddylai ffonio. Gaddewch i mi y gwnewch chi.
chunks: the people who worry about making a fuss are exactly the ones who should ring
y bobl sy'n poeni am neud ffys ydy'n union y rhai ddylai ffonio
two sy'-relatives round an identificatory ydy — Welsh cannot leave either relative bare as English does
Gaddewch i mi y gwnewch chi
English's stranded auxiliary needs a full Welsh y-clause with the verb restated

turns.en: Alright, alright, I promise. My daughter will make me anyway.
turns.cy: Iawn, iawn, dw i'n gaddo. Mi wneith fy merch i i mi beth bynnag.
chunks: My daughter will make me anyway
Mi wneith fy merch i i mi beth bynnag
the causative gneud i, whose object erases here because the verb is understood

turns.en: Good - let her. That's everything from me. Any last questions?
turns.cy: Da iawn — gadwch iddi hi. Dyna bob dim gen i. Unrhyw gwestiynau ola?
chunks: 'let X' takes gadael i, so English's bare object becomes a conjugated iddi hi

turns.en: None, doctor. Thank you for being so thorough.
turns.cy: Dim un, doctor. Diolch am fod mor drylwyr.
